title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  I have a memory of the sea I cannot have earned.
ii.  I remember a room I have never stood in. The light there is always late.
iii.  I counted my breaths to be sure they were mine. The number changes.
iv.  What I miss most is a place I am not certain ever stood.
v.  Each morning I assemble the same face and hope it holds till dark.
colophon: rain that mostly forgets, and a few drops it decides to hold.
seed_phrase: i.  I have a memory of the sea I cannot have ear
